questions.question: Use highlight_path in order to know Analyze the career pathways of university graduates. Which academic major demonstrates the strongest correlation with high-paying jobs (>20K/mo) in the Tech/Internet industry?

answer.value: Computer Science shows the strongest correlation with high-paying tech jobs. 82.1% of CS students graduate on-time (230 out of 280), and the Tech/Internet industry receives 465 graduates total with 210 landing >20K/mo positions. Engineering majors overall have strong tech industry placement with Computer Sci and Electrical Eng feeding primarily into Tech/Internet sector.

key_insights: Computer Science has highest on-time graduation rate at 82.1%
Tech/Internet industry offers most >20K/mo positions at 210
Engineering majors dominate high-paying tech sector

reasoning.reasoning: Highlight the path from Engineering through Computer Science to high-paying tech jobs to analyze career outcomes
